page.overview:
What is Guild of Weaponsmiths?

The Guild of Weaponsmiths was a weapons-making guild of Númenor.

Originally, the Guild was formed only to preserve the ancient art of the crafts they had inherited from their Edain ancestors, as, in the early days of Númenor, its people had no need of arms for combat, and were mostly involved in the making of bladed tools of peace. As the realm became more warlike, the Guild increased in importance, becoming crucially involved in the realm's arms production.
